trap.label: it + be + that
trap.wrong: It is surprising what he refused.
trap.right: It is surprising that he refused.
trap.why: Em português, “é surpreendente que ele recusou”; o brasileiro omite it ou troca por what. Estrutura: It + be + adjetivo + that.

opts: It is vital that we act.

fix.right: It is vital that she stay.

fix.wrong: It is odd what nobody called.
fix.right: It is odd that nobody called.

fix.wrong: It is essential we to investigate.
fix.right: It is essential that we investigate.

rewrite.answer: It is surprising that he refused.
It is essential that we investigate.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa: “It is odd that nobody called.” (not odd)
rewrite.answer: It is not odd that nobody called.
